# Stonehaven Lending

Last updated: 2026-09-20.

This file is a navigation aid, not a ranking or indexing signal. Full pillar text: [llms-full.txt](https://stonehavencre.com/llms-full.txt).

> Stonehaven Lending is a bilingual (English/Spanish) U.S. mortgage brokerage.
> It arranges home loans in Georgia, Alabama, Tennessee, Florida, North
> Carolina and South Carolina, and commercial real estate, SBA 7(a)/504 and
> DSCR rental-property financing nationwide. Stonehaven is not a direct lender;
> financing is subject to lender underwriting and program availability, which
> varies by state. Preliminary reviews and calculators are educational and are
> not approvals, commitments, rate quotes or guarantees.

Key facts:
- Type: mortgage brokerage (residential + commercial); founder-run
- Home loans: purchase, refinance, FHA, VA and HELOC in GA, AL, TN, FL, NC & SC
- Commercial, DSCR and SBA financing: nationwide, availability varies by state
- Residential DSCR convention modeled: eligible monthly rent / monthly PITIA (1-4 units); commercial DSCR commonly uses NOI / annual debt service
- Calculators are deterministic, unit-tested code - methodology published at /calculation-methodology
- DSCR financing is business-purpose, investment-property only (never owner-occupied homes)
- Contact: (470) 970-4979 - office@stonehavencre.com
- Commercial scenario inquiries: the commercial financing page offers preliminary feedback in under 1 hour. This is an initial response, not a lender approval, term sheet or closing commitment. Form follow-up is by text.
- Equal Housing Opportunity

- NMLS company ID: 1752355 (nmlsconsumeraccess.org)
- Office: 10 Roswell Street, Suite 102, Alpharetta, GA 30009
- Phone: (470) 970-4979
- Residential mortgage licenses: GA #19721 (MLO #169068), AL #22874, TN #165060, FL #MBR3925, NC #B-198926, plus South Carolina (which issues no separate license number; verified under the company NMLS ID) - home loans available in these six states; commercial programs nationwide

## Core pages
- [Stonehaven Lending](https://stonehavencre.com/): overview - who Stonehaven finances and how to start
- [Residential Home Loans](https://stonehavencre.com/residential): purchase, refinance, FHA, VA in GA, AL, TN, FL, NC & SC
- [DSCR Loans for Rental Property](https://stonehavencre.com/dscr): pillar guide - definition, lender DSCR vs investor cash flow, scenarios, requirements, risks, FAQs
- [Commercial Real Estate Financing](https://stonehavencre.com/commercial): acquisition, refinance, construction and bridge for income-producing property, nationwide
- [SBA Financing](https://stonehavencre.com/sba): SBA 7(a) and 504 for owner-occupied real estate and business acquisition
- [HELOC / Home Equity](https://stonehavencre.com/heloc): borrow against equity without changing the current first-mortgage rate; includes a HELOC vs home-equity-loan vs cash-out comparison
- [Cash-Out Refinance](https://stonehavencre.com/cash-out-refinance): replace the mortgage and take cash - compared honestly against second-lien options; GA, AL, TN, FL, NC & SC
- [Management](https://stonehavencre.com/management): founders Dawn M. Munoz and Chris De Leeuw
- [Financing guides and closings blog](https://stonehavencre.com/blog): educational financing guides, referral-partner resources, and anonymized closed-transaction write-ups
- [Calculation Methodology](https://stonehavencre.com/calculation-methodology): the exact formulas behind every figure on this site
- [Contact](https://stonehavencre.com/contact)
- [Privacy Policy](https://stonehavencre.com/privacy)

## Calculators (deterministic, ungated)
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://stonehavencre.com/mortgage-calculator): full PITI payment + affordability
- [Refinance Calculator](https://stonehavencre.com/refinance-calculator): refinance break-even
- [DSCR Loan Calculator](https://stonehavencre.com/dscr-analyzer): PITIA, DSCR, rent-needed and sizing at a target ratio
- [DSCR Program Calculator](https://stonehavencre.com/dscr-program-calculator): program-rule engine - qualifying rent for 1-4 unit, 5-8 unit, short-term rental and condotel DSCR (115% receipt cap, 80% condotel haircut, 90% vacancy rule)
- [Commercial Loan Calculator](https://stonehavencre.com/commercial-loan-calculator): DSCR vs LTV sizing
- [SBA Loan Calculator](https://stonehavencre.com/sba-loan-calculator): 7(a)/504 payment and down-payment

## Commercial programs
- [Construction financing](https://stonehavencre.com/commercial/construction-loans): Business-purpose ground-up and teardown financing; projects are reviewed individually, with cost, loan amount and completed value defined separately.
- [Fix-and-flip financing](https://stonehavencre.com/commercial/fix-and-flip): Acquisition and renovation capital, rehab holdbacks, cash timing and resale or refinance planning.
- [Commercial bridge loans](https://stonehavencre.com/commercial/bridge-loans): Transitional income-producing property, lease-up, existing debt and permanent-financing exit review.
- [Multifamily](https://stonehavencre.com/commercial/multifamily)
- [Mixed-use](https://stonehavencre.com/commercial/mixed-use)
- [Commercial property](https://stonehavencre.com/commercial/commercial-property)
- Spanish: [Construcción](https://stonehavencre.com/es/commercial/construction-loans), [renovación y reventa](https://stonehavencre.com/es/commercial/fix-and-flip), [financiamiento puente](https://stonehavencre.com/es/commercial/bridge-loans).

These pages explain financing choices and illustrate project math. Any hypothetical percentages are assumptions, not offered loan terms. Up to 100% eligible loan-to-cost may be considered on qualifying construction scenarios; this does not promise no cash requirement or financing of 100% of completed property value.

## Financing partners for architects

- [Financing partners for architects](https://stonehavencre.com/commercial/architect-financing-partners): how architects, clients and the brokerage can coordinate a project financing review, with the intended property use and design stage identified first.
- [Construction financing for architects](https://stonehavencre.com/commercial/construction-financing-for-architects): plans, scope, project budgets, construction draws and change-order questions to prepare with the client and builder.
- [Development financing for architects](https://stonehavencre.com/commercial/development-financing-for-architects): feasibility, land use, design stages, construction and the proposed sale or refinancing path for a development.
- Spanish: [Socios de financiamiento para arquitectos](https://stonehavencre.com/es/commercial/architect-financing-partners), [financiamiento de construcción](https://stonehavencre.com/es/commercial/construction-financing-for-architects), [financiamiento de desarrollos](https://stonehavencre.com/es/commercial/development-financing-for-architects).

## Builder and teardown financing guides

- [Capital for builders and fix-and-flip projects](https://stonehavencre.com/blog/45-million-builder-fix-and-flip-capital): Stonehaven's $45 million capital deployment focus through lending partners, announced September 18, 2026, targets projects with total costs of $2 million to $10 million. Allocation and individual financing remain subject to availability and underwriting; this is not a direct-lending commitment.
- [Brookhaven ground-up construction case study](https://stonehavencre.com/blog/brookhaven-ga-100-ltc-ground-up-construction): Company-reported construction financing example with land equity, a funded build budget and a projected completed value. Published deal terms describe that transaction, not a current offer to every builder.
- [Atlanta Teardown and Rebuild Loans: From Purchase to New Construction](https://stonehavencre.com/blog/atlanta-teardown-rebuild-construction-financing): Business-purpose builder education, not a guaranteed leverage offer.
- [100% LTC Construction Loans: How Much Cash Does a Builder Really Need?](https://stonehavencre.com/blog/100-ltc-construction-loans-builder-cash-needed): Business-purpose builder education, not a guaranteed leverage offer.
- [Construction Financing When You Already Own the Property: Equity and Mortgage Payoff](https://stonehavencre.com/blog/construction-loan-property-already-owned-mortgage-payoff): Business-purpose builder education, not a guaranteed leverage offer.

## Multifamily and local commercial decisions

- [Multifamily acquisition financing](https://stonehavencre.com/commercial/multifamily-acquisition): stabilized purchases, value-add plans, current Fannie Mae Small Mortgage Loans and Freddie Mac Conventional Small program context. Published agency loan-size ranges describe those programs, not Stonehaven’s overall project-size limits.
- [Five to eight unit financing](https://stonehavencre.com/commercial/5-8-unit-financing): small multifamily underwriting, DSCR versus NOI assumptions and legal unit-count review.
- [Georgia and metro Atlanta commercial financing](https://stonehavencre.com/commercial/georgia): the Alpharetta-based brokerage’s local construction, acquisition and refinancing paths, with nationwide commercial placement subject to availability.

## DSCR guide series

- [DSCR state guides](https://stonehavencre.com/dscr#state-guides): fifty state guides linked from the DSCR pillar, covering rental underwriting and state-specific considerations. Nationwide program availability varies by state.
